question: After blind critical-center correspondence, are small rooted wiring neighborhoods preserved more strongly when structural role is preserved than when role is broken, and does that conservation remain local at radius 1 or compose outward to radius 2?

rationaleParentV6.purpose: V6 adjudicated residual turn rate and tortuosity as non-protected at the tested resolution, motivating the next test at the wiring-neighborhood level.

motifConstruction.root: every blindly mapped v4 critical center in a V5 pair-eligible observation pair
motifConstruction.neighborhood: induced center-to-center multigraph neighborhood containing every center at unweighted graph distance <= radius from the root; neighbors do not need to survive cross-observation correspondence
motifConstruction.edgeMultiplicity: all literal parallel center-to-center paths collapsed to one undirected neighborhood edge carrying multiplicity class
motifConstruction.selfLoops: retained as local edge tokens but do not expand breadth-first radius
motifConstruction.topologyVariant: edge labels contain multiplicity class only
motifConstruction.lengthAwareVariant: edge labels contain multiplicity class plus mean observation-diagonal-normalized path-step bin

canonicalization.method: rooted Weisfeiler-Lehman refinement over the induced radius-limited multigraph plus an identity-free structural token multiset
canonicalization.fingerprintUse: exact motif equality is a secondary strict observable, not an isomorphism theorem
canonicalization.gradedDistance: multiset Jaccard distance over identity-free node and edge structural tokens
canonicalization.whyTwoViews: the strict fingerprint detects reusable identical rooted motifs while the graded token distance preserves sensitivity when one local structural token changes

pairAggregation.rootWeighting: each blindly mapped root contributes equally inside its observation pair
pairAggregation.gradedPairMetric: mean rooted motif multiset-Jaccard mutation across mapped roots
pairAggregation.exactPairMetric: fraction of mapped roots whose strict rooted motif fingerprint differs

discovery.effect: family-pair-balanced smaller-is-more-conserved rank effect; positive means motif mutation is smaller in role-preserving pairs
discovery.nullShuffle: shuffle preserved/broken observation-pair labels within each physical occupant-family pair while preserving the original preserved count
discovery.selection: none; all four primary observables are predeclared and all secondary exact observables are reported

adjudication.radius1Only: If a radius-1 primary topology observable meets the Cleveland evidence gate and Bavaria transfer gate but the corresponding radius-2 observable falls below practical magnitude, treat syntax as sharply local around junction/endpoint neighborhoods.
adjudication.radius2Composes: If radius-2 meets the Cleveland evidence gate and Bavaria transfer gate without collapsing relative to radius 1, local wiring motifs compose outward and become candidate structural syllables for the next sequence experiment.
adjudication.lengthRefinesTopology: If length-aware conservation materially exceeds topology-only conservation at the same radius, normalized physical span is part of motif identity rather than merely an edge-level constraint.
adjudication.topologyDominates: If topology-only equals or exceeds length-aware conservation, motif identity is primarily adjacency/multiplicity structure.
adjudication.noMotifSignal: If all primary Cleveland effects remain below 0.08 or fail the predeclared null gate, do not construct a motif alphabet from this representation; test distributed/global graph organization next.

descriptiveInventory.report: for each radius/variant, count distinct fingerprints, fingerprints recurring in >=2 distinct sourceGroupIds, and fraction of roots belonging to such cross-source recurring fingerprints

falsifiers.parentDrift: If the V5 manifest, edge world, projector rows, or role-pair rows fail their frozen hashes, abort.
falsifiers.insufficientRoots: If an eligible observation pair has no blindly mapped roots, exclude it transparently; if fewer than 50 Cleveland pairs remain, abort the motif claim.
falsifiers.radiusCollapse: If radius-1 signal survives but radius-2 collapses, do not call radius-2 structure compositional.
falsifiers.transferCollapse: If a Cleveland motif signal reverses or falls below 0.08 in Bavaria, do not call it transferable syntax.
falsifiers.inventoryWithoutCorrespondence: Cross-source motif recurrence alone is descriptive and cannot substitute for preserved-vs-broken correspondence evidence.
